run.failed: The report could not be generated
run.doneTitle: The report was generated and archived
run.intro: Creates an archivable PDF/A report of this run: what was done and when, results, decisions, checks and evidence, with a sign-off block and empty digital signature fields. Every report is stored unchanged, and its SHA-256 is recorded in the audit log.
run.interimHint: This run has not finished yet. The report will be marked as an interim report.
run.commentHint: Optional. Printed in the report with your name and the time, e.g. the result of your review.
run.classificationHint: Optional. Leave empty to use the default from the report branding settings.

panel.intro: Archived PDF reports of this run. Files are never changed; generating again creates a new version. The SHA-256 of each file is recorded in the audit log, so an archived copy can be verified later.
panel.notYet: Reports can be generated when the run has finished or is waiting for a decision

summary.title: Summary report
summary.failed: The summary report could not be generated
summary.doneTitle: The summary report was generated and archived
summary.intro: One PDF for audits: all runs of the selected processes in a period, with status, who started them, decisions, changes and failed checks, plus totals. It is archived and its SHA-256 is recorded in the audit log.
summary.endBeforeStart: The end must not be before the start
summary.commentHint: Optional. Printed in the report with your name and the time.

verify.title: PDF report verification
verify.exactText: This file is exactly the report generated by this installation. Its SHA-256 is recorded in the audit log.
verify.signedText: The beginning of this file is exactly the generated report; data was appended afterwards, typically digital signatures. Check the signatures in your PDF reader.
verify.unknownText: No report with this content was generated by this installation (or you may not view it). The file may have been changed.
verify.importedHistory: the imported audit history of the instance with key fingerprint {{fingerprint}} (moved here with a migration package) – not this instance's own audit log
verify.archiveRemoved: The stored copy was removed by data retention; the audit log still proves the content.
verify.forgedText_one: The audit log contains an entry that claims to record this file but fails the integrity check (HMAC or chain position). It was inserted outside Steward and is ignored.
verify.forgedText_other: The audit log contains {{count}} entries that claim to record this file but fail the integrity check (HMAC or chain position). They were inserted outside Steward and are ignored.

branding.title: Report branding
branding.intro: Used for all new PDF reports (run reports and summaries). Reports that were already generated are not changed.
branding.logoTooLarge: The logo must not be larger than 1 MB.
branding.logoHint: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB. A wide logo with a transparent background works best.
branding.companyNameHint: Shown next to the logo. Empty: {{brand}}
branding.classificationHint: Printed on every page, e.g. Internal or Confidential. It can be changed per report.
branding.footerNoteHint: Optional, e.g. Confidential – for internal use only

contrast.title: Readability
contrast.graphics: Lines, section markers and chart bars in this color barely stand out from the white page (contrast {{ratio}}:1, at least 3:1 recommended). Consider a darker color.
